::: {#exr-shape-rule}

#### Which of these products are defined?

Let $\matr{A}$ be $4 \times 3$, let $\matr{B}$ be $3 \times 2$, and let $\vx \in \reals^3$.
For each expression, say whether it is defined,
and if so give the shape of the result:

1.  $\matr{A}\matr{B}$
2.  $\matr{B}\matr{A}$
3.  $\matr{A} \vx$
4.  $\vx\' \vx$
5.  $\vx \vx\'$

:::
